synthetic_known_answer_counterexamples_s.known_ground_truth: `line.1:active_power_from` (RTU .11) increases 100->300, whereas `line.1:active_power_to` (RTU .12) decreases in magnitude |-100|->|-40| and has COT test bit `T=1` at the step sample. Must be flagged as `explicit_evidence_constraint_conflict` in B1 and rejected from bridges in MIRAGE-OT.

One ASDU (`apci_tx=31`) from RTU `172.16.3.18` carries two objects (`bus.5` and `load.3`), is mirrored at two vantages (`n302` and `n318`, 4 packet objects: 1 primary + 1 same-ASDU diff IOA + 2 true cross-vantage mirrors), and produces 2 IPAL rows (6 raw observations total). True container count is 1.

Unverified `switch.99:is_closed=0` (no prior baseline) occurs 4s before `line.4` drops to zero at both `to` (RTU .18) and `from` (RTU .22) ends. The 2 cross-device links from `switch.99` are `unsubstantiated_temporal_candidates` (not proven false conflicts), while `line.4` (`to` <-> `from`) is 1 `corroborated_same_device_candidate` forming 1 Cross-RTU Bridge.

A `communication_change` anchor on `n302` cites 4 TCP packets at different times across 3 ephemeral sessions (`56094` FIN, `56736` two SYN retries, `56752` SYN). Because all 4 packets are on `n302` at different times, `true_cross_vantage_mirror_duplicate_count` must be 0, with 1 `distinct_messages_in_same_tcp_session_count` and 2 `distinct_time_network_events_in_anchor_count`.
